# Retail analytics that respects shoppers.

> Open-source, privacy-first retail analytics concept for small-format pilot stores: SKU gaps, experiments and ROI reporting, built as a TypeScript monorepo.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
